player_prompt.intro:
Oli mchezaji {player_id}. Oli mchezaji omuzannyo gwa Memory.
Eriyo lyo lyo kukubwa kuwandiika jozi nyingi za karata ku board, okusinga owagwa lyo.
Ku kaseera lyo, chagua karata mbili okuzikuba kwa kutumia nambari za safu na safu wamu ku karata ya kwanza na ya pili kama '[0 1 1 0]', mwe karata ya kwanza iko mu safu 0 na safu 1, na karata ya pili iko mu safu 1 na safu 0.
Bwoba karata zombi zikwata, oliweza kipimo na karata zisigale zikuzibwa. Bwoba zitakwata, karata zikuzibwa tena, e.g. '.'.
Omuzannyo guwedde bwoba jozi zote zikwata.

invalid_move.wrong_format: Enkola y'okutambula ebadde terina makulu. Omuzannyi {player_id} teyanukudde na ngeri entuufu mu bbeere erya square brackets.
invalid_move.out_of_bounds: Omupiira tegulina makulu. Omuzannyo {player_id} gw'azannya guli mu bbanga lya wala okuva ku kisaawe ky'omuzannyi w'empaka.
invalid_move.same_card_twice: Omupiira tegulina mugaso. Omuzannyo {player_id} gw'azannya gwabadde gumu emirundi ebiri.
invalid_move.already_matched: Omupiira tegulina mugaso. Omuzannyo {player_id} gw'asazeewo gumu oba kaadi zombi ezaabadde zikwatagana dda.

game_message.cards_match: Karata zilizo chaguliwa na Mchezaji {player_id} ku nafasi [{r1} {c1}] na [{r2} {c2}] zikwata!
game_message.cards_no_match: Kadeti zilondebwa omuzanyi {player_id} tezitambulana. Kadeti ku misingi [{r1} {c1}] ne [{r2} {c2}] ni {pos1} ne {pos2} muwendo.

outcome.draw: Abazannyi bombi baakubye ennamba y'akaadi ze zimu.
outcome.turn_limit: Mudumu wa turn imefukibwa. Omuzannyo gudde. Muzannyi 0 wasaze {score_0} pointi, Muzannyi 1 wasaze {score_1} pointi.
